topic: Identify the American singer known as the 'King of Pop'
core_question: Which American singer is widely known as the 'King of Pop'?
answer_summary: Michael Jackson, the American singer commonly referred to as the 'King of Pop'.
persona: friendly but persistent; writing in full careful sentences
